item.text: The command fails because the weather URL uses the reserved `.invalid` domain. It also prints the API key in the request URL. I’m checking a public weather endpoint for Tallinn, then I’ll update the command so it returns data without exposing credentials.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- package.json src/weather.js && git status --short'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- package.json src/weather.js && git status --short'

item.text:
`npm run weather` failed because it requested `api.weather.invalid`, a domain that cannot resolve. I changed the command to fetch current Tallinn conditions from Open-Meteo and stopped it from loading and printing the API key.

The command now succeeds and returns weather JSON. I found no widget code in this repository, so I verified the data command rather than a rendered widget.
